title: Kernel selector regression: rollback + temporary routing for affected quantized LLMs
creator: Maya Chen
description: Multiple paying customers and internal smoke tests surfaced a 20-40% regression in tokens/sec and a TTFT increase for specific quantized LLM variants (int4/int8) after the runtime's kernel selector change (decision to prefer the new cuBLAS-fused attention kernel on Ampere/Grace). Regression appears across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments when sequence length > 512 and KV cache per-request > ~1MB. Impact includes increased downstream latency SLO violations, customer escalations to support, and elevated cost per token. We need a fast mitigation (rollback kernel-selector heuristic and route affected traffic to verified fallback model variants), a patch to the selector logic, and follow-ups to add deterministic perf tests and better canarying for kernel changes.
description_plain: Observed 20-40% tokens/sec regression for quantized models after kernel selection change. Roll back selector, route affected customers to verified variants, and add perf tests and canarying. Includes Hosted/Dedicated/Private impact and immediate mitigation plan.
comments: 2026-03-11 08:42 - Maya Chen: Initial report from SRE: elevated TTFT for customer 'EduScale' on hosted region us-west-2 after runtime deploy. Reproduced on a staging Ampere cluster with our quantized Llama-2-large-int4 profile. Alert created and paging triggered.

2026-03-11 11:10 - Carlos Ortega: Triage complete. Root cause candidate: new kernel selector prefers cuBLAS-fused attention kernel for >512 seq on Ampere. The fused kernel exhibits worse memory layout for small batch sizes with large KV, causing extra memcopies and L2 eviction; throughput drops ~30% on our quantized kernels. Created temporary traffic rule to avoid fused kernel for affected models (hotpatch attempt failed on Private due to differing protobuf).

2026-03-11 14:55 - SRE Team (Ana Patel): Implemented emergency routing: traffic for flagged customers and model tags (quantized-4/quantized-8) is routed to fallback selector profile that pins to legacy matmul kernel. Observed tokens/sec recovery to previous baseline for customers routed. Metrics: EduScale tokens/sec returned to 95% of baseline, TTFT improved by 28%.

2026-03-11 18:20 - Carlos Ortega: Opened PR #4521 to rollback the kernel-selector change to previous heuristic while we harden the compatibility matrix. Seeking urgent review from infra owners. Added unit/regression test to perf-suite (perf/regression/quant_kernels).

2026-03-12 09:03 - Support (Liam Novak): Notified affected customers of mitigation and temporary routing. Two customers requested dedicated capacity patching; coordinated with Account Execs. No data loss; only performance regression.

2026-03-12 12:40 - Maya Chen: Verified across Dedicated private deployment in customer lab (on-prem Grace cluster) — had to apply an out-of-band selector flag due to older runtime package pinned by their ops team. Patch applied and confirmed recovery. Need rollout checklist for Private installs.

2026-03-12 16:10 - Carlos Ortega: PR #4521 merged to release branch and promoted to runtime-1.19.2-hotfix. Post-deploy monitoring flagged small memory regression in unrelated microbench; tracking as ENG-37210. Also opened PR #4528 to add kernel compatibility matrix and explicit per-GPU heuristics.

2026-03-13 09:30 - QA (Priya Ramesh): Added deterministic perf test cases to CI: quant-int4/int8 with seq lengths 128/512/1024 and KV sizes 256KB/1MB/4MB. These are gated behind perf-accept before any kernel-selector changes can be merged. QA will run extended canary for two days in us-west-2 after hotfix rollout.

2026-03-13 13:45 - Product (Ethan Yu): Product and Sales updated customers; we should prepare a short postmortem and include cost delta estimates for impacted invoices where SLA credits might apply. Assigned follow-up to SRE for SLA delta calculation.

2026-03-13 16:00 - Carlos Ortega: Next steps: 1) Monitor hotfix in Hosted for 72 hours. 2) Backport selector-compat-matrix and add unit/perf tests (ENG-37245). 3) Create Private rollout doc and quick patch instructions (ENG-37246). 4) Draft postmortem and communicate to CSMs (target 2026-03-18).
